# Transition style

**How does one shot or section move to the next?** · [all approaches](index.md)


## Hard cuts on beat or motion
<a id="hard-cuts"></a>

Plain cuts, placed on a beat or on movement.

**Looks like:** Shot changes land on the kick drum or mid-gesture, so they feel invisible.

**Good at:** clean; fast to make; never dated

**Weak at:** no flourish for section changes; no energy boost on their own

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals speed, retention · effort low

**How:** Cut on beat markers in Edits/CapCut, or on movement.

**Backed by:** [Hard cuts; motion only on overlays](../topics/transitions.md#tr-hard-cuts-motion-on-overlays), [Cut on the beat or on motion](../topics/editing.md#edit-cut-on-beat-motion), [Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade), [Voice cadence as pattern interrupt](../topics/sound.md#sound-voice-cadence-interrupt) · sources L06, SP, KH

## Whip pan
<a id="whip-pan"></a>

About 5 frames of horizontal motion blur plus a whoosh and hit into the next framing.

**Looks like:** The shot smears sideways for a split second, whoosh, and you are in a new framing. It's energetic but clean; L10 chose it over a recursive zoom.

**Good at:** energy; section changes; clean (vs flashy zooms)

**Weak at:** overuse feels like a template; needs matching motion or blur

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals retention · effort low

**How:** CapCut 'whip' transition, or ffmpeg directional blur over 5 frames plus a whoosh SFX.

**Backed by:** [Whip pan over recursive zoom](../topics/transitions.md#l10-whip-not-recursive-zoom), [Horizontal wipes and slide-ins](../topics/transitions.md#tr-kinetic-wipes), [Demo each effect on your own shot](../topics/effects.md#l10-apply-effect-on-yourself), [Axial jump cuts every 3–6 words](../topics/editing.md#edit-axial-jump-cuts) · sources L10

## Kinetic wipes and board zooms
<a id="kinetic-wipes"></a>

Horizontal wipes, text slide-ins or a zoom across a board to the next step, each with a whoosh.

**Looks like:** A wipe carries the next idea in from the right; or the camera glides across a step board to step 3, then pulls back to the whole map at the end.

**Good at:** teaching structure; a sense of progress; matches whooshes for polish

**Weak at:** needs graphics; slower than cuts

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long, carousel · niches tech, all · goals saves, retention · effort medium

**How:** HyperFrames wipe blocks; CapCut slide transitions with ease-out.

**Backed by:** [Horizontal wipes and slide-ins](../topics/transitions.md#tr-kinetic-wipes), [Zoom/pan the board to each step](../topics/transitions.md#tr-board-zoom-to-step), [Whip pan over recursive zoom](../topics/transitions.md#l10-whip-not-recursive-zoom), [Before/after slider reveals the grade](../topics/effects.md#l10-grade-slider-reveal) · sources L07, L04

## Glitch, colour bars, CRT static
<a id="glitch-static"></a>

A TV colour-bar glitch or a static burst between sections or chapters.

**Looks like:** A one-frame burst of colour bars, then the next section. Or a chapter card arriving on a CRT TV with static.

**Good at:** tech and gaming flavour; clear chapter breaks; fast to add

**Weak at:** dated if overused; noisy

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long · niches tech, gaming · goals retention · effort medium

**How:** CapCut glitch transitions; HyperFrames CRT and glitch blocks plus a static SFX.

**Backed by:** [TV colour-bar glitch transition](../topics/transitions.md#tr-glitch-colour-bars), [Chapter cards: chrome emblem, CRT static](../topics/transitions.md#tr-crt-static-chapter), [Chapter sounds: risers, booms, set foley](../topics/sound.md#sound-riser-sub-boom-chapters), [Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade) · sources R1, L07

## Reveal moves and trend transitions
<a id="reveal-trend"></a>

Pan-to-reveal, fan-blade wipe, flip or similar trend transitions; ending on a thud and cut to black.

**Looks like:** The camera pans off the sun to reveal the group, or an object passes the lens to wipe to the next scene. The reel ends on a thud into black.

**Good at:** wow moments; travel and vibe reels; trend reach

**Weak at:** needs planned shots; trend transitions date fast

**Best for:** formats reel30, yt-short · niches travel, gym · goals reach, shares · effort medium

**How:** Shoot both halves with matching motion; join in CapCut with a mask or match cut.

**Backed by:** [Pan to reveal the subject](../topics/transitions.md#tr-pan-reveal), [End on a thud and cut to black](../topics/transitions.md#tr-cut-to-black-thud), [Travel shots: silhouettes, backs, slow-mo](../topics/filming.md#film-travel-shots), [Before/after slider reveals the grade](../topics/effects.md#l10-grade-slider-reveal), [Trending audio only when it fits](../topics/sound.md#sound-trending-audio-fit) · sources KH, L08, research

## Mixing
Most sources use hard cuts for the body and one stronger transition for section changes. L10 skipped the recursive zoom as 'a bit too much'.

## Rule of thumb
Default: hard cuts. Section changes with energy: whip pan. Step-by-step teaching: wipes. Tech chapters: glitch. Vibe and travel: reveals.
